A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we show that, under a mild condition on the algorithm (self-consistency), the FDR control is implied by the control of the probability that the p-values are not “too dependent”, in three classical types (independence, positive dependency, unspecified dependency).
we give a unified framework for the FDR control of multiple testing procedures, which is based on two simple sufficient conditions.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the control of FDR can be reduced to two simple conditions.
